name: Outlier streaming engine benchmarks (V9 paged vs retired V10/V11)
description: Decode tok/s, RSS, and Metal wired-memory for Outlier's V9 paged engine vs retired V10/V11 streaming engines, Plus 397B and Vision 35B, M1 Ultra, 5+ run aggregation.
creator: Outlier (Matt Kerr)
hardware: M1 Ultra; 5-run mean per config, fresh process per run, OS-level RSS sampled per token

v9_paged_plus_397b.config: K=20 hot experts/layer + 8 GB LRU cache (the app's setting until build 1.11.593; it ships K=40 since)
v9_paged_plus_397b.note: tok_per_sec and rss_gb are this dataset's own per-token RSS-sampling protocol, at the old K=20 setting. The shipping figure the rest of the site publishes is 2.0 tok/s, 79 s to the first token and 18.0 GB peak memory, measured 2026-06-24 through the shipped app (build 1.11.593) at its K=40 setting, M1 Ultra with 64 GB, MLX 4-bit: the decode rate the app itself reports. Until 1.11.593 the app ran K=20 (1.59 tok/s, 14.04 GB peak in the 2026-05-01 sweep).

retired_v10_v11.why_retired: 57-58 GB wired during prefill could crash a 32 GB Mac for only 30-40% gain; V9 uses 3.6 GB wired (15x less)
